name: Bus protection isolator-replica interface
summary: Relates measured disconnector positions to the current assignment used by the bus protection.
description: Relates measured disconnector positions to the current assignment used by the bus protection. A protection scheme combines measurements, decision elements and communication or trip outputs to protect a defined part of the network. A function number names a job; the scheme interface shows how that job connects to other equipment.

In a substation feeder bay, local current and voltage measurements may combine with a remote-end signal before the protection issues the assigned trip request. Backup actions use their own defined initiations and supervision. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Disconnector replica states” at the input and “Current-to-zone assignment” at the output. Invalid position information requires defined handling.

Keep each protected zone, initiating quantity, blocking signal and trip destination distinct. Settings, communication performance and coordination require the approved protection study and selected relay documentation. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
